---
title: "Default Long Date"
author: "Norah Jones"
date: "2026-07-01"
# Title-block parity corpus (bd-gx9cic8z, P4 bd-13f821l5): with no
# date-format, the styled HTML title block forces the `long` style
# (Q1's documentTitleMetadata rule): July 1, 2026. The head's
# dcterms.date stays ISO via date-meta.
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        - [
            "<p class=\"date\">July 1, 2026</p>",
            "<meta name=\"dcterms.date\" content=\"2026-07-01\">",
          ]
        - ["<p class=\"date\">2026-07-01</p>"]
---

Body.
